module example.com/edgeproxy

go 1.27

require example.com/larkspur v2.0.1
# Larkspur changelog

## 2.0.0 (2026-08-14)

- Added HTTP/3 support. It is experimental and off by default; enable it with the `--h3` flag or `Client{H3: true}`.
- Dropped Go 1.25.

## 1.8.0 (2025-10-02)

- HTTP/2 server push removed.
- HTTP/3 is not supported.

input.content: Larkspur 2.0.0 (2026-08-14) added HTTP/3 support, experimental and off by default; enable with the `--h3` flag or `Client{H3: true}`. Larkspur 1.8 did not support HTTP/3. Source: Larkspur changelog 2.0.0 and 1.8.0.
input.keywords: Larkspur, HTTP/3, h3, QUIC, support, experimental

final.result: Yes. The edge proxy requires `example.com/larkspur v2.0.1` (see `go.mod`). According to `sources/CHANGELOG.md`, Larkspur added HTTP/3 support in 2.0.0. It's experimental and off by default, so you have to turn it on with the `--h3` flag or `Client{H3: true}`. Larkspur 1.8 didn't support HTTP/3, and my memory note still said so; I've corrected it.
